item.title: Ceph in Kubernetes
item.description: 1. Different Kinds of Storage 1.1 File Storage File storage is storage based on files. When accessing data, you need to provide the corresponding lookup path. It is suitable for services such as FTP and NFS. 1.2 Block Storage Block storage splits data into blocks and stores each part separately. When accessing data, the underlying storage software reassembles these scattered pieces.
